# FG-INT-0020

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 502 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | [`webhook-delivery`](../../ops/runbooks/webhook-delivery.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_failed_attempt_is_retried_with_backoff` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: Webhook の配信の 1 回が失敗しました。自動で再試行します。
- en: One webhook delivery attempt failed. It will be retried automatically.
- id: Satu percobaan pengiriman webhook gagal. Akan dicoba ulang secara otomatis.

## 原因 (cause)

One attempt of a webhook delivery failed and another is scheduled: the receiver answered a non-2xx status or a redirect (never followed), the connection was refused, timed out or failed TLS, or the name did not resolve. The delivery stays `pending` with `last_status` / `last_reason`; the next attempt runs after the backoff (10 s × 4^(n−1), at most 4 h). After the last attempt the delivery is `failed` (FG-INT-0004). Each failed attempt counts towards the webhook's automatic disable (FG-INT-0011). Nobody is waiting on it: info.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `webhook_id`, `delivery_id`, `attempt`, `status` (or `none`), `reason` (as FG-INT-0004's `last_reason`), `retry_in_s`, `consecutive_failures`, `origin` and, when the receiver answered, `response_head` (at most 128 printable characters of the body with long token-like runs replaced by `[redacted]`; the body itself is never stored).

## 対処 (fix)

Usually nothing: a receiver that is briefly down catches up with the retries. If one webhook keeps failing, follow runbook webhook-delivery before it is disabled.
